title: Lead Qa Engineer - Ai/Ml
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Qa Engineer - Ai/Ml em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Lead QA Engineer - AI/ML

Location: Remote (Brazil/Mexico)

Contract

About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.

Role Overview

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking Lead QA Engineer to drive our quality strategy, with a strong emphasis on test automation and AI-driven testing solutions.
  • This role combines leadership, technical expertise, and innovation to deliver high-quality software at scale.
  • You will lead QA initiatives, mentor a team of engineers, and champion modern approaches to quality engineering, including machine learning and AI-assisted testing—while maintaining deep expertise in manual and blackbox testing practices.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and implement the QA strategy with a focus on automation-first and AI-enhanced testing.
  • Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers across both manual and automation disciplines.
  • Establish best practices, standards, and KPIs for quality engineering.

Automation Excellence

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks.
  • Drive adoption of CI/CD-integrated testing pipelines.
  • Ensure high test coverage across:
    • UI
    • API
    • Performance
    • Security layers

AI-Driven Testing

  • Evaluate and implement AI/ML tools for:
    • Test generation
    • Maintenance
    • Defect prediction
  • Leverage AI for:
    • Intelligent test case prioritization
    • Self-healing test scripts
  • Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and integrate them into QA workflows.

Manual & Blackbox Testing Leadership

  • Define and oversee comprehensive blackbox testing strategies, including:
    • Exploratory testing
    • Usability testing
    • Regression testing
    • End-to-end testing
  • Ensure thorough validation of business requirements and user flows without reliance on internal code knowledge.
  • Lead complex manual testing efforts for new features, edge cases, and high-risk areas.
  • Establish best practices for:
    • Test case design
    • Test data management
    • Defect reporting

Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure testability and scalability.

Quality Advocacy

  • Promote a culture of quality ownership across teams.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure timely defect resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in both automated and manual (blackbox) testing methodologies.
  • Proven experience designing and executing:
    • Detailed manual test plans
    • Exploratory testing
    • End-to-end validation
  • Deep understanding of blackbox testing techniques, including:
    • Equivalence partitioning
    • Boundary value analysis
    • User-centric validation
  • Strong expertise in test automation frameworks:
    • Selenium
    • Playwright
    • Cypress
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language:
    • Python
    • Java
    • JavaScript / TypeScript (preferably)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools:
    • Jenkins
    • GitHub Actions
    • GitLab CI
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies and SDLC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands‑on experience with AI/ML tools in QA (e.g., test generation, visual testing, anomaly detection).
  • Familiarity with AI‑powered testing platforms or frameworks.
  • Experience balancing manual exploratory testing with automation strategies in complex systems.
  • Experience with performance testing tools:
    • JMeter
    • k6
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms:
    • AWS
    • GCP
    • Azure
  • Experience with containerization:
    • Docker
    • Kubernetes

Key Skills

  • Leadership and team development
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for AI in testing
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to deeply understand user behavior through manual testing approaches

  • Acompanhar a entrega dos veículos vendidos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Representar a concessionária do Grupo NewChase em feiras, eventos e lançamentos de novos produtos, promovendo os veículos e serviços da marca.
  • Monitorar as tendências do mercado automotivo, novas tecnologias e atividades da concorrência, identificando oportunidades de negócio e sugerindo ações para aumentar a competitividade do setor.
  • Realizar os cursos presenciais e via WEB da montadora e do Grupo, através do cronograma de cursos enviado pela Diretoria de Recursos Humanos, a fim de garantir a aprovação e manutenção do índice definido pela montadora.
  • Executar outras tarefas que venham a ser delegadas pelo(a) gestor(a) da área.

• Pessoas pretas e pardas;

Assim nasce o Programa Passaporte Franquia, que aproxima as pessoas com mais de 18 anos das oportunidades de vagas de emprego nas lojas franqueadas da maior rede de viagens do Brasil. Dando o "match", ou seja, o franqueado aprovando o candidato após etapa de seleção e entrevista, o mesmo informará data de início da jornada e detalhes da contratação. Você pode se candidatar em quantas vagas desejar, em diferentes localidades!

Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Design, Pedagogia, Engenharia, TI ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês intermediário (conversação) e avançado (leitura);
  • Experiência com as ferramentas Google for Education (Classroom, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc);
  • Vivência com atendimento presencial e atendimento de chamados;
  • Experiência com tecnologias educacionais e dispositivos como iPads, Sphero, etc;
  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 1.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 2 e Trainer, e semelhantes;
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ativas, Cultura Maker e Design Thinking;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de gerenciamento de dados, acervo e chamados (iSAMS, ServiceDesk+, AgendaEdu, Seesaw);
  • Experiência em escolas ou outros ambientes educacionais.

Perfil desejado

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens; espera-se o mesmo do contratado, incluindo o cumprimento dos treinamentos de safeguarding pertinentes à função. About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.

Role Overview

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI‑driven solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM‑based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI / ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI / CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS data services (Glue / PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI‑enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade‑offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI / CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit‑learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross‑functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM‑based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

Job Description

Talent Manager (Independent Contractor) Must send resume in English

Overview

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and elevate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.

Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)

Technical Requirements

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals

Note

This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

Visual Designer – Marketing

Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.

You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.

What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast‑turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.

What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks

Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short‑form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.

What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel‑perfect, weeks‑per‑project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall

You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.

If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

For a visual rich mobile app with natural imagery. We are seeking a designer who can plan and design at the same time, while owning media (pictures, UI, other artworks) to a consistent premium style.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the overall creative direction across brand, product, and user‑facing experiences.
  • Curate a consistent image/video library
  • Define presentation patterns (cards, overlays, visuals).
  • Edit assets (color correction, cleanup, crops/ratios, background variants) and export optimized outputs for mobile.
  • Ensure consistency in taste, tone, quality, and emotional appeal across all creative outputs.
  • Design key visuals/ screens (gallery/grid, detail, collections, rewards).
  • Own the overall visual direction and aesthetic quality of the product and brand.

Engagement

  • Must‑have

  • Graphic design skills
  • Systems mindset: style guides, naming conventions, templates, and content standards.
  • Nice‑to‑have
  • Experience with content-heavy apps (media galleries, digital apps, UI, motion specs).

How to apply

  • Apply with: (1) portfolio link (Behance/Dribbble/Figma/website)

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)

You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns

You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.

Operations & Logistics Manager (E-commerce)

We’re looking for an Operations & Logistics Manager who can keep products moving smoothly—from supplier to customer—without drama. If you love building systems, solving shipping puzzles, and making fulfillment faster + cheaper, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Remote/Brazil | Full-time

What you’ll own

You’ll be the glue between supply chain, fulfillment, and customer experience. Key responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Manage end-to-end logistics: inbound freight, warehousing/3PL, outbound shipping
  • Own relationships and performance with 3PLs, carriers, freight forwarders, and vendors
  • Improve shipping speed, accuracy, and cost (fewer “where is my package?” moments)
  • Oversee inventory flow and replenishment planning to prevent stockouts/overstock
  • Create and maintain SOPs for receiving, picking/packing, returns, and exception handling
  • Build dashboards for key KPIs (OTIF, shipping cost per order, fulfillment accuracy, returns rate)
  • Lead continuous improvement projects (process, tools, automation, packaging optimization)
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with CX, marketing, finance, and product team on launches and promos

What success looks like (90 days)

  • 3PL/carrier performance clearly tracked and improved
  • Fewer shipping issues and faster resolution time
  • Clear SOPs and smoother handoffs between teams
  • Inventory is more predictable (less “oops we ran out”)
  • Shipping costs are controlled while service levels stay strong

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in logistics/operations (bonus: DTC e-commerce, Shopify, Amazon, or retail)
  • Strong vendor management skills (hold partners accountable politely but firmly)
  • Solid understanding of shipping and freight (domestic and/or international)
  • Comfortable with data and spreadsheets (measure stuff, not just feel)Organized, proactive, and calm when things go sideways
  • Process builder: document, improve, and automate—not just do the work

Tools you may use (nice to have)

Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite/QuickBooks, ShipStation/ShipBob, 3PL portals, Asana/ClickUp, Airtable, Google Sheets/Excel, Zapier/Make

Why join us

We’re growing fast and need someone who can help us scale without breaking fulfillment. You’ll have real ownership, a direct impact on profitability and customer experience, and a team that moves quickly.

How to apply

Send your resume and a short note answering:

  • What’s one logistics or fulfillment process you improved, and what changed?

Confira esta oportunidade para Ugc Content Creator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location : Remote Type : Freelance / Contract

Compensation : R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)

Probation period : 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week

About Pure

Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.

We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.

About the UGC Creator Community

We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (TikTok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.

As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.

What You’ll Do

Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc)

Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression

Drive people to the app

Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns

Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance

Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies

What We’re Looking For

You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese

Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture

Familiarity with TikTok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos

Strong on-camera presence and editing skills

Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals

Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships

Payment Structure

Tiered structure paid weekly

Bonuses for views (starting from 100K+ views)

Bonuses for registrations

Payments are made weekly

Why Join Us

Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression

Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators

Build your portfolio while collaborating

Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective

How to Apply

Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app.

You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video.

After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

We are seeking a highly strategic and hands‑on AI Solutions Engineer with strong experience in delivering end‑to‑end AI and Generative AI (GenAI) initiatives. Preferred Qualifications

  • Strategic “challenger” mindset with strong outcome orientation
  • Analytical thinking and structured problem‑solving
  • Strong communication and executive presence
  • Adaptability and resilience in undefined environments

Additional Notes

This is a strategic role focused on delivering measurable business impact through AI innovation. The professional is expected to influence decision‑making, shape transformation agendas, and build long‑term value through scalable and sustainable solutions.

Estamos em plena expansão, com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.

É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência :

  • O Agora (Execução e Precisão) :

Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.

Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.

Qualificações Obrigatórias

É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:

O Agora (Execução e Precisão)

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.

O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura)

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , usando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.
  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.

title: Key Account Pleno/Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Pleno/Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Key Account Pleno/Sênior Options & Company – Salvador, Bahia, Brazil

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um profissional com profunda capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamentos de alto valor, visão estratégica de longo prazo e histórico comprovado na expansão sustentável de carteiras complexas. O Key Account Pleno / Sênior será o guardião das contas mais relevantes da organização – responsável não apenas por preservar a receita existente, mas por identificar, estruturar e capturar sistematicamente novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema de cada cliente.

Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão e Expansão de Carteira

    Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento.

    Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up‑sell e cross‑sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão.

    Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação.

    Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, road‑maps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento.

  • Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica

    Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes – operacional, gerencial e executivo – criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente.

    Posicionar‑se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.

    Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.

    Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.

  • Retenção e Crescimento de Receita

    Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.

    Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.

    Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.

    Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.

  • Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

    Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.

    Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.

    Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.

    Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta – consumo, receita, engajamento, risco – para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível – QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases – com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up‑sell e cross‑sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi‑stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.
  • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial).
  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós‑graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial.
  • Trabalho 100% Presencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar uma vez por semana.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica – compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional – lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono – assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados – transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada – identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva – articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional – mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.

Benefícios & Experiência na empresa

  • Estrutura e Segurança – Cartão Flash flexível (alimentação / refeição / mobilidade), Plano de Saúde completo, Seguro de Vida, Café da manhã diário no escritório.
  • Alta Performance & Saúde Integral – Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade com treinamento físico, acompanhamento nutricional e acesso ao TotalPass (academias e bem‑estar).
  • Consultas médicas.
  • Cultura e Ambiente – orientação à alta performance com responsabilidade, proximidade com tomada de decisão, ambiente meritocrático, troca constante com profissionais de alto nível.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to sit at the center of how our engineering organization works with AI — spanning tooling support, an internal agentic SDLC platform, and product incubation. You will work closely with the AI Enablement Lead, Director of Engineering, and product leadership to translate internal AI workflows into features we ship to customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the day‑to‑day configuration and optimization of AI coding and productivity tools;
  • Act as the primary point of contact for engineers, triaging and resolving issues like integration failures, model compatibility, or configuration drift;
  • Maintain onboarding documentation and runbooks to ensure engineers of all levels can use AI effectively;
  • Run enablement sessions and office hours to drive adoption and guide engineers on best practices for AI‑assisted development;
  • Gather feedback from teams to translate real usage patterns into continuous improvements for workflows and tooling;
  • Drive the refinement and expansion of an internal agentic pipeline that connects specification, implementation, testing, and validation into a coherent automated workflow;
  • Own the integration layer between AI agents and the development toolchain, including third‑party integrations, execution environments, and context injection strategies;
  • Advance specification quality by building tooling, templates, and workflows that help engineers write specs that agents can act on reliably;
  • Design and run experiments to validate agent configuration decisions and translate findings into platform improvements;
  • Evaluate emerging tools and platforms for potential integration into the agentic workflow;
  • Serve as the primary internal test bed for AI‑powered features and workflows intended to ship to external customers;
  • Collaborate with product and engineering leadership to translate internal learnings into product insights and roadmap inputs;
  • Prototype AI‑assisted developer experiences that can graduate into product features for SaaS customers;
  • Maintain a rigorous dogfood culture by using products internally and bringing insights back into the development process.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role with any backend language such as PHP, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, .NET, or Golang;
  • 1+ years of hands‑on experience with LLM‑based tools or agentic workflows in a professional setting;
  • Hands‑on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Windsurf, Amp, or Cursor;
  • Comfort working across multiple technologies and a mixed‑technical environment;
  • Direct experience deploying and supporting AI coding assistants across a large engineering team, including configuration, rollout, and troubleshooting;
  • Ability to understand complex engineering problems and design practical, scalable solutions;
  • Familiarity with LLM infrastructure concepts including model routing, API proxying, token management, and model versioning;
  • Strong written communication skills;
  • Comfort working with engineers at varying AI maturity levels;
  • Experience working with automated testing toolchains in a CI/CD context;
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with PHP and/or C# environments;
  • Hands‑on experience building or operating agentic AI workflows, including multi‑step agent pipelines and tool/API integration;
  • Experience with spec‑driven or structured software specification methodologies;
  • Background in SaaS product development;
  • Experience in a developer tools, testing tools, or security software company;
  • Experience working in distributed teams across multiple time zones.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

A Beezz.ai desenvolve ecossistemas de agentes autônomos integrados para operações comerciais. Não somos uma fábrica de chatbots. Tratamos IA como motor do produto, mas entendemos que sem fundamentos sólidos de engenharia nada disso escala nem se mantém confiável em produção. Instagram: Instagram

O que esperamos de você! Estamos num momento em que o campo muda toda semana. Ferramenta nova, paradigma novo, capability nova. Também buscamos maturidade e senso de responsabilidade.

A Beezz está crescendo rápido, e quem entra agora tem caminho aberto para subir de cargo, assumir autonomia sobre projetos e, em pouco tempo, liderar produtos com equipe própria. Isso significa que não queremos alguém que só executa tarefa — queremos alguém que toma decisão, assume consequência e entrega.

Se você quer um trabalho previsível e bem delimitado, provavelmente não é aqui. Se você quer crescer junto com a empresa e ter espaço pra construir, vamos conversar.

Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura de agentes: projetar fluxos agênticos— orquestração multi-agente, máquinas de estado, controle de fluxo, recuperação de erros e loops de auto-correção.
  • Integração modelo-ferramenta: desenvolver e manter camadas de comunicação entre LLMs e sistemas externos, seguindo protocolos abertos e padrões de interoperabilidade.
  • Ferramentas para agentes: criar function callings customizados com foco em idempotência, segurança, observabilidade e performance.
  • Recuperação de contexto: implementar e refinar pipelines de Recuperação Aumentada por Geração (RAG)— estratégias de chunking, embeddings, reranking, hybrid search e avaliação contínua de qualidade.

  1. Fundamentos de Engenharia: Experiência sólida em pelo menos uma linguagem que exija entendimento profundo de fundamentos de computação – gestão de memória, tipagem estática forte, concorrência de baixo nível ou modelos de execução explícitos.

    Python em nível avançado: programação assíncrona, tipagem forte e validação de dados em runtime.

  2. IA & Agents: Prática comprovada em orquestração de agentes— grafos de estado, workflows multi-etapa, roteamento condicional, paralelismo e controle de contexto.

    Entendimento de protocolos de comunicação entre modelos e ferramentas externas e padrões de integração abertos.

    Engenharia de prompts e integração com modelos SOTA de múltiplos provedores, com domínio dos trade-offs de custo, latência, janela de contexto e capacidade.

    Persistência de dados: relacional, NoSQL e vetorial. Busca semântica, estratégias de indexação e otimização de recall / precision.

    Uso ativo ou contribuição em ecossistema de IA open source.

  3. Infraestrutura e Arquitetura Cloud pública com ênfase em serverless e sistemas orientados a eventos.

    Infraestrutura como código e automação de ambientes.

    Microsserviços, arquitetura hexagonal e separação clara entre domínio, aplicação e adaptadores.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi‑Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting a multicultural and multifunctional environment.

Main Responsibilities

Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission‑critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.

Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.

Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD‑WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.

Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.

Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.

Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.

Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.

Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.

Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.

Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.

Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.

Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi‑Fi, SD‑WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.

Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD‑WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.

Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).

Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi‑platform integration and international performance with remote teams.

Soft Skills

Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.

Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.

Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.

Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.

Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have

Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.

Experience with underground networks, mining‑specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.

Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from large mining companies.

Ability to work in different time zones, multi‑site environments and multicultural teams.

Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.

Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.

Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.

Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.

Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.

Additional Comments

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil‑Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

Conquer AI is hiring an Intelligence Architect to help us design and deliver real‑world AI systems for enterprise clients in Brazil.

This is not a research‑only role, and it is not a strategy‑only role.

We are looking for a strong software engineer who can work directly with clients, run technical discovery, shape use cases, and then build the solution from POC through MVP and Phase 1 delivery.

  • Strong software engineering background
  • Experience with RAG, LLMs, machine learning, and AI application development
  • Strong hands‑on skills in Python and Node.js
  • Ability to design, build, and deploy production‑ready systems
  • Confident working directly with clients and cross‑functional stakeholders

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with clients to uncover high‑value AI opportunities

This Role is a Fit for You

  • You are a builder first
  • You can speak to executives, operators, and engineers without losing the thread
  • You enjoy solving messy workflow problems with elegant technical systems
  • You want to work on high‑impact AI delivery, not internal experiments

We’d love to hear from engineers who want to build serious AI systems in the real world.

  • Expert level proficiency in React Native for building high‑performance reusable components for both iOS and Android
  • State Management Mastery of Redux, MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence

  • Experience implementing offline capabilities using WatermelonDB, Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity
  • CI/CD Pipelines – Experience with Fastlane, Bitrise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines
  • Testing Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end‑to‑end E2E automation
  • Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing

Key Responsibilities: AMS Context

  • Mobile App Support – Lead the resolution of Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents affecting global mobile users from UI glitches to critical sync failures
  • OS Compatibility – Proactively manage app updates to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS and Android versions and hardware releases
  • Complex Change Requests – Translate requirements from Sales and Marketing leads into technical mobile features, design, develop and test enhancements
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) – Perform deep‑dive analysis on app crashes, API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes
  • SLA Stewardship – Ensure all mobile services meet strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for our 24/7 global field operations
  • Technical Mentorship – Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for React Native in the India hub providing guidance to junior developers and UI/UX designers

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori for mobile or SAP Mobile Services
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth IoT integration for warehouse scanning applications
  • Experience with mobile security best practices – biometrics, certificate pinning

Company and Compensation

Company: Hirebus

Pay: $30K-$60K per year

Mid‑Level Engineer – AI + Code Quality

We're hiring a mid‑level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM‑powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.

What You’ll Do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool‑calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety

Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands‑on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM‑powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool‑use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self‑directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI‑native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow

Your First 90 Days

  • Month 1: You’ll have shipped real bug fixes. You’ll be in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You’ve identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You’ve shipped a meaningful refactor. You’ve made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.

We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

Em 2014, a empresa ganhou novo impulso com a chegada de Rafael Bacetto, filho do fundador Nei, trazendo ainda mais força, visão de crescimento e inovação para expandir o sonho de transformar lares por toda a Bahia. Com o ritmo crescente das operações, 2019 marcou a inauguração do primeiro Centro de Distribuição, reforçar o estoque e aprimorar a experiência do cliente. Já em 2026, mesmo diante de um cenário desafiador, o Baianão continuou avançando e inaugurou o novo CD Em Porto Seco com mais do que o triplo da capacidade logística do anterior: foram mais lojas abertas em Salvador, região metropolitana, e interior Feira de Santana, candeias, São Sebastião de Passé, Dias D'Ávila, gerando empregos e levando conforto e esperança para milhares de famílias. Atualmente já conta com 43 três lojas. Em setembro de 2025, o Baianão avançou na transformação digital , reforçando seu E-commerce alcançando lares em todo o Brasil e mergulhando de vez no varejo online integrando a o marketplace às lojas físicas e ampliando a experiência do cliente, conectando cada vez mais os canais de venda. Com visão empreendedora, implantou em 2025 novos sistemas como ERP TOTVS, trazendo segurança nas informações entre todas as áreas que compõem nossa companhia, isso se traduz em compromisso com o consumidor. Implantou a metodologia em técnicas de vendas: A PONTE, chancelada pela Sucesso em Vendas, uma das principais consultorias em vendas a nível nacional. Um time que hoje supera 900 colaboradores, o Baianão segue crescendo, superando desafios e se consolidando como um verdadeiro ícone baiano. Ainda em 2025, mais um marco importante foi alcançado com a inauguração da loja conceito em Itapuã, um espaço moderno, acolhedor e repleto de novidades, simbolizando a evolução contínua da marca. O Baianão não para. O futuro reserva novas lojas, novos projetos e novas oportunidades para quem deseja fazer parte dessa história construída com trabalho, inovação e paixão por transformar lares. Vem pro Baianão. No Baianão, você pode muito mais!

Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais : Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.

You’ll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long‑term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.

Specifically, your role will involve:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients’ business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up‑to‑date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.

The ideal profile

We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:

  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast‑paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem‑solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data‑driven mindset for decision‑making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full‑time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get‑togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social.   • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

A Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Conduzir vendas consultivas de soluções de TI (software, cloud, serviços, outsourcing, etc.); Identificar dores, desafios e objetivos estratégicos dos clientes, traduzindo-os em soluções tecnológicas; Elaborar e apresentar propostas comerciais e técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do cliente; Negociar contratos, preços, prazos e condições comerciais, garantindo rentabilidade; Atuar como ponto focal entre o cliente e as áreas internas (técnica, pré-vendas, operações e suporte); Construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes e decisores estratégicos; Acompanhar a jornada do cliente desde a prospecção até o pós-venda; Prever estimativas de fechamento (forecast) e reportar resultados à liderança; Participar de reuniões de revisão de pipeline e metas.

Formação superior em áreas correlatas; É necessário ter carro e notebook próprio; Conhecer e ter bom relacionamento com empresas da região (empresas da Zona da Mata e região); Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B na área de Tecnologia da Informação; Vivência com vendas consultivas de soluções tecnológicas (software, serviços, cloud, infraestrutura, segurança, etc.); Experiência no relacionamento com clientes corporativos e tomadores de decisão (gestores, diretores e matriz); Conhecimento prático em metodologias de vendas, evidenciando abordagem estruturada (SPIN Selling, BANT, Sandlers entre outras); Fortes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e escuta ativa; Postura centrada no sucesso do cliente, realizando um atendimento de excelência com foco na resolução de problemas; Organização e planejamento para cumprir metas em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado; Disponibilidade para viagens.
